summary: Implement a minimal stateless Node.js 22 HTTP health service using only built-in http and node:test. A single exported server factory (app.cjs) is consumed by both the executable startup entry (server.cjs) and real ephemeral-loopback-port tests (test/health.test.cjs). No database, Docker, identity provider, third-party packages, or cloud infrastructure.

tasks.description: Package manifest with start/test/build scripts, engines node>=22, CommonJS .cjs convention, no dependencies.

contracts.description: npm start runs server.cjs; npm test runs node --test; npm run build runs node --check on all source files

tasks.description: Exported HTTP server factory app.cjs routing GET /health to 200 {"status":"ok"} and all other routes to 404 JSON error.

contracts.description: createServer() factory returns an http.Server that maps GET /health to 200 and status ok, and any other path/method to 404 with JSON error body
Unknown request must not break subsequent /health responses (stateless handler)

tasks.description: Executable startup entry server.cjs that imports the factory, listens on process.env.PORT default 3000, with portable entrypoint detection.

contracts.description: server.cjs creates the app and listens on PORT (default 3000); startup stays separate so tests never bind a fixed port

tasks.description: Real HTTP tests on ephemeral loopback port covering health, unknown route, and health again; close the server after tests.

contracts.description: npm test performs actual HTTP requests on a loopback ephemeral port: GET /health -> 200 {status:ok}, unknown route -> 404 JSON, GET /health again -> 200; server closed in teardown, no mocks

tasks.description: README with install/start/test instructions and a source-to-requirement mapping.

contracts.description: README documents npm install/start/test/build usage and maps each FR/NFR to its source and test file

tasks.description: Traceability matrix mapping each requirement to implementation files and tests.

contracts.description: Trace each FR/NFR to concrete files and test files

tasks.description: Architecture decision record documenting minimal built-in-only scope and factory/startup separation.

contracts.description: Record decision to use only built-in http/node:test and to separate factory from executable startup

assumptions: A1 (assumption): No database, Docker, Compose, gateway, identity provider, or OpenAPI are required; the original documents explicitly exclude them, so none are produced.
A2 (assumption): CommonJS .cjs extension is applied to all source and test files per NFR2's 'consistent CommonJS conventions with .cjs source files'.
A3 (assumption): The 404 error JSON body shape is fixed as {"error":"not found"} since the design requires 'a JSON error' but does not specify field names (origin=assumption).
A4 (assumption): package.json has zero dependencies and zero devDependencies, relying entirely on Node built-ins.
